rows.definition: Vulkan fused wrapper helper checking all selected weight-slot pointers have sufficient nominal resident buffer bytes while their live owners and command-stream lock are retained.
rows.distinction: These slots are expert weight bindings, unlike the scheduler Slot free/busy signal. The helper checks nominal bytes only and does not validate stale aliases, device generations, or dispatch-grid limits.

rows.definition: Pure bounded Q2_K token-panel geometry carrying output/input widths, exactly 2/4/8 rows, validated byte extents and the workgroup count for the three-int32 shader push ABI.
rows.distinction: An immutable launch geometry result, not a recorded Vulkan command buffer or a device qualification claim.

rows.definition: Pure planner that validates Q2_K matrix geometry, block divisibility, signed 32-bit byte bounds and exactly 2/4/8 token rows before returning V41Q2KTokenPanelPlan.
rows.distinction: Performs host arithmetic admission only; the returned plan holds geometry while provider capability and opt-in decide whether native execution is available.

rows.definition: Pure bounded Q3_K token-panel geometry carrying output/input widths, exactly 2/4/8 rows, 110-byte quantized block extents padded to four bytes, and workgroup count for the three-int32 shader push ABI.
rows.distinction: An immutable launch geometry result for Q3_K storage rather than Q2_K geometry or a recorded Vulkan command buffer; does not qualify native device execution.

rows.definition: Pure planner validating Q3_K matrix geometry, block divisibility, padded 110-byte block storage, signed 32-bit byte bounds and exactly 2/4/8 token rows before returning V41Q3KTokenPanelPlan.
rows.distinction: Host arithmetic admission for Q3_K storage; the result contains geometry while provider capability and opt-in independently control execution. Distinct from the Q2_K planner.

rows.definition: Pure lookup of a supplied CUDA weight-operation declaration table for an operation, exact storage/scale format and covered generic architecture; missing, duplicate, unknown or malformed rows fail closed.
rows.distinction: A source declaration lookup, not the actual backend capability advertised by Caps.FusedAttn, a linked-artifact census, device probe, model admission, numerical parity or hardware-performance witness.

rows.definition: Private dtype-only predicate for membership in the CUDA source-declared MatMul format table, preserving the existing nine accepted weight dtypes without adding architecture admission.
rows.distinction: A dtype-only source declaration membership test without target admission, unlike CUDADeviceOpSupported which checks a supplied operation/format table and generic architecture. Neither predicate is Caps.FusedAttn actual backend lowering capability, a linked-artifact census, model admission or hardware qualification.

rows.definition: CUDA device and launch-geometry eligibility check for fused Qwen attention postprocessing.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention dispatch or the fused enqueue function, this performs no allocation, enqueue, KV mutation or attention arithmetic; checks device zero, capture state, token bounds, threads, shared memory and grid limits.

rows.definition: CUDA F32 fused Q/K RMS normalization, partial RoPE and owned KV-tail append enqueue for Qwen sequence prefill.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention score computation or backend dispatch, processes projected Q/K/V using the fixed 24-query/4-KV-head 256-dimension contract. It validates live pointer extents and rejects overlap before the single fused kernel; does not publish Go KV lengths.

rows.definition: Mutex-held Go sequence owner for opt-in CUDA fused attention postprocessing and exact KV append publication.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention backend dispatch or the C enqueue primitive, validates tensor ownership and append frontier, owns query transient and error drain, and advances KV lengths only after successful enqueue. It never retries a selected failing operation over a partially written cache.

rows.definition: Mutex-held Go owner for fused resident F32 Q/K normalization, partial RoPE and KV append publication.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention implementation dispatch, validates panels and frontiers, invokes existing COW append admission, owns query transient and publishes three append lengths after successful checked recording. It is not the numerical kernel or C eligibility predicate; selected errors remain errors and never authorize replay.

rows.definition: Mutation-free C eligibility predicate for the specific Vulkan fused attention postprocess path.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention implementation dispatch, evaluates ABI-qualified pipeline availability, grouped-head/rotary/numeric bounds, signed-index extents and workgroup geometry. It does not select a broader attention algorithm or record commands.

rows.definition: Checked C Vulkan command-recording boundary for fused Q/K normalization, partial RoPE and KV-tail outputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention implementation dispatch, validates submission state, buffer extents and nonaliasing, selects scalar/table RoPE input, constructs the push ABI and records the postprocess dispatch. It does not own Go COW/frontier publication or attention score computation. Unlike the similarly named CUDA F32 enqueue boundary, this operates on Vulkan Buffer allocation identity and records through the Vulkan batch dispatcher with scalar/table RoPE; it does not use CUDA pointer attributes or CUDA streams.

rows.definition: Mutex-held Vulkan Go owner consuming interleaved per-head Q/G F32 panels and publishing separately owned rotated query, unchanged gate and KV append outputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike the split-Q postprocess owner, consumes doubled-width QG and owns an additional gate transient. Unlike attention implementation dispatch, owns specific tensor/frontier/COW admission and selected-error lifecycle; selected errors never authorize replay.

rows.definition: Mutation-free eligibility predicate for Vulkan fused interleaved-QG postprocessing.
rows.distinction: Unlike split-Q postprocess eligibility, additionally preserves doubled QG signed-index limits and the original split flattened-grid admission. Requires both QG and predecessor availability; unlike general attention implementation dispatch, records no commands and selects no attention score algorithm.

rows.definition: Checked Vulkan command-recording boundary for direct interleaved QG consumption, Q/K normalization, partial RoPE, unchanged gate extraction and three KV-tail outputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike split-Q postprocess recording, uses eleven descriptors, independent gate output, doubled QG input extent and five output nonalias checks. Copies gate unchanged, not sigmoid or gate application; owns recording checks, not Go cache lengths or attention score dispatch.

rows.definition: CUDA device attention entrypoint reading F16 or BF16 position-major attended KV planes with F32 queries and online-softmax accumulators.
rows.distinction: Unlike fak_qwen35_attention_postprocess_f32, which normalizes and rotates projection rows while writing F32 KV, this entry reads already populated typed KV and produces grouped causal attention output; it does not mutate cache rows or normalize projections.
